name: Bhushan Karande
title: Machine Learning Engineer
bio: I am a Machine Learning Engineer focused on production AI systems: LLMs, RAG pipelines, recommendation models, and agentic workflows. Recent work includes clickstream-based recommendation, model-serving latency improvements, and multi-agent report generation.
My background spans applied ML, backend engineering, and numerical methods. I like building systems that are useful beyond the demo: measurable, debuggable, and practical enough for real users.
